plainText:
Tara Jayne Sands is an American voice actress who has been in English-language dubs of and . She is sometimes credited as simply Tara Jayne or Tara Sands. She is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Sands was a voice actor on starting with its first season. She had provided the voices of many characters of the day until the end of the seventh season. After her departure, archived audio was used to voice all of the that appeared in the show (most frequently May's Bulbasaur) until Michele Knotz took on the role. Her most prominent roles on Pokémon the Series are that of Ritchie and Ash's Bulbasaur.

In 2016, Sands lent her voice to characters in Pokémon Generations. She returned to Pokémon the Series in Pokémon Journeys: The Series, now being credited under her full name. She voices Professor Cerise's Yamper.

Aside from her work on Pokémon, she was also the co-host of Fridays on until 2007. Sands currently lives in Los Angeles, working independently.

In 2023, Sands started a Podcast series called 4Kids Flashback where she and her co-host Steve Yurko share memories and behind-the-scenes stories about working at 4Kids Entertainment.
